research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: AmpUp is researching electric utility load distribution systems and methods, focusing on establishing interfaces with power distribution systems to manage outlets for utility-facing devices. They are also developing systems and methods for charging electric vehicles with charging stations in areas of low connectivity, and methods for facilitating charging sessions by aggregating and adjusting power outputs of EVSE units. These efforts address load management, connectivity challenges, and session facilitation in EV charging.

about_short_description.short_description: AmpUp is an electric vehicle charging company that enables drivers, hosts, and fleets to charge stress-free.

product.name: AmpUp EV Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based EV charging management platform for monitoring, controlling, and optimizing commercial charging stations, including analytics, access controls, pricing, load management, and reporting.

product.name: AmpUp EV Driver App
product.description: A mobile and web-based application that helps EV drivers locate, reserve, access, and pay for charging sessions at AmpUp-enabled stations.

product.name: AmpUp Adapt & Earn
product.description: A managed EV charging and demand-response program that shifts charging away from peak periods, with incentives for participating drivers and visibility for utilities and grid operators.

product.name: AmpUp EV O&M Service
product.description: An operations and maintenance service for EV charging networks that provides continuous monitoring, remote issue diagnosis, maintenance coordination, and support to keep chargers operational.
